Chandrapal is believed to represent the power, strength, and protective nature of the moon god. This name is widely used in Hindu culture, particularly among the Brahmin community, and is often given to children as a part of their spiritual upbringing.

Chandrapal is also a symbol of inner illumination, a reminder that just as the moon reflects the light of the sun, the soul reflects the divine light within. It is a name that inspires devotion, faith, and a connection to the divine.
